title: Customer Reference Program Consent Form (Draft v2)
content:
Redwood Inference — Customer Reference Program Consent Form (Draft v2)

Last updated: 2025-10-23
Prepared by: Redwood Inference Legal (Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes)

IMPORTANT: This is a consent form for marketing and sales enablement use of Customer’s name, logo, statements, and (if approved) performance/security metrics. This form is intended to be simple and is not a substitute for an NDA, MSA, DPA, BAA, or other governing agreement.

1) Parties
This Customer Reference Program Consent Form (the “Consent”) is entered into by and between:

Company: Redwood Inference, Inc. (“Redwood”)
Address: [Redwood address]

Customer: [Customer Legal Name] (“Customer”)
Address: [Customer address]

Effective Date: [Effective Date]

2) Purpose and scope
Customer agrees to participate as a customer reference for Redwood’s products and services (including Hosted API, Dedicated, Private/VPC/on‑prem, Redwood Console, and Redwood Optimize) for the limited purposes described in this Consent.

Participation may include one or more of:
- public case study (web page and/or PDF)
- customer quotes/testimonials in marketing materials
- permission for Redwood to use Customer’s logo/name in customer lists
- participation in reference calls with prospective customers
- participation in webinars/events (optional; requires separate written confirmation of specific event details)

3) Permissions (choose what Customer approves)
Customer grants Redwood the following permissions, subject to Section 5 (Review and approvals), Section 6 (Metrics and proof), and Section 9 (Revocation):

3.1 Use of name and logo
[  ] Approved: Redwood may use Customer’s company name and logo in Redwood marketing materials and on Redwood’s website (e.g., “Customers” section, case study page, sales collateral).
[  ] Approved with restrictions (describe): [restrictions, e.g., “logo only on case study page; no homepage”; “no use in paid ads”]
[  ] Not approved

3.2 Quotes and testimonials
[  ] Approved: Redwood may use Customer-provided quotes and/or excerpts from Customer interviews in marketing materials.
[  ] Approved with restrictions (describe): [e.g., “no individual employee names”; “title only”; “paraphrase only”]
[  ] Not approved

If approved, attribution preference (select one):
[  ] Attribute by individual name + title + company (e.g., “Jane Doe, VP Engineering, Customer”)
[  ] Attribute by title + company only (e.g., “VP Engineering, Customer”)
[  ] Company only (e.g., “Engineering leader at Customer”)
[  ] Anonymous / de-identified attribution (e.g., “Enterprise fintech company”) — requires Redwood and Customer to agree in writing on the de-identification language prior to publication

3.3 Public case study asset
[  ] Approved: Redwood may publish a public case study featuring Customer’s use of Redwood.
[  ] Approved as “lightweight story” only (short-form web page; no PDF; no blog)
[  ] Not approved

Case study formats (if approved):
[  ] Redwood website case study page
[  ] PDF one-pager
[  ] Blog post (customer story)
[  ] Sales deck insert / customer story slide
[  ] Press release (requires separate written approval prior to release)

3.4 Reference calls (private, prospect-facing)
If approved, Redwood may request that Customer participate in reference calls with prospective customers under the guardrails below.

[  ] Approved
[  ] Not approved

If approved, reference-call guardrails:
- Maximum call frequency: [  ] 1 / month  [  ] 2 / month  [  ] Other: [___]
- Scheduling lead time required: [___] business days
- Call duration: typically 30 minutes unless otherwise agreed
- Topics Customer prefers to avoid (optional): [e.g., “roadmap”; “pricing”; “specific vendor comparisons”; “incident details”]
- “Cooldown” option after a call: [  ] 30 days  [  ] 60 days  [  ] None

4) No obligation; no endorsement; no exclusivity
- Customer participation is voluntary.
- Nothing in this Consent requires Customer to provide a positive endorsement. Customer may decline any specific request.
- Customer is not granting exclusivity; Customer may participate in other programs.
- Redwood will not represent that Customer endorses Redwood beyond the approved statements and approved use of name/logo.

5) Review and approvals (required prior to public use)
5.1 Written approval required for publication
Redwood will provide Customer with any proposed public-facing materials that include Customer’s name/logo/quotes/metrics (e.g., case study draft, PDF, blog post, press release snippet) prior to publication.

Customer must provide written approval (email is acceptable) before Redwood publishes or otherwise distributes the materials publicly.

5.2 Review window
Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Customer will have ten (10) business days to review materials provided for approval.

If Customer requests changes within the review window, the parties will work in good faith to resolve them. Redwood will not publish until Customer provides written approval.

5.3 Brand guidelines
Customer may provide brand guidelines (logo usage, colors, do-not-use variants). Redwood will comply with reasonable brand requirements.

6) Metrics and proof (optional; choose what can be shared)
Many customers prefer not to share exact performance or cost metrics. Redwood will follow Customer’s selections below.

6.1 Permission to disclose metrics
Customer approves the following level of metric disclosure (select one):
[  ] Exact metrics allowed (e.g., “p95 latency improved from 900ms to 420ms”; “$ / 1M tokens reduced by 35%”)
[  ] Ranges only (e.g., “reduced p95 latency by 30–50%”) and/or qualitative statements (“materially reduced latency/cost”)
[  ] Qualitative only (no numbers, no percentages)
[  ] No metrics (Redwood may describe implementation only)

6.2 Types of metrics that may be disclosed (select all that apply)
[  ] Latency (e.g., p50/p95)
[  ] Throughput (req/s, tokens/s)
[  ] Reliability/availability (uptime, error rate)
[  ] Cost metrics (e.g., $/1M tokens, infrastructure reduction)
[  ] Operational metrics (time-to-launch, engineering time saved)
[  ] Security/compliance posture statements (e.g., “deployed in VPC,” “KMS integrated,” “audit logs enabled”) — subject to Section 6.4

6.3 Method and caveats
If Redwood includes metrics, Redwood will:
- specify (at a high level) what was measured and when (baseline period vs. post-Redwood period)
- include reasonable caveats (e.g., workload-dependent; configuration-specific)
- avoid implying that results are guaranteed for all customers

6.4 Security and compliance statements
If Customer approves security/compliance statements, Redwood will only publish statements that Customer confirms are accurate and permitted for public disclosure.

Customer restrictions/notes (optional):
- Prohibited statements: [___]
- Required language (e.g., “Customer-managed KMS integration” vs. “HIPAA compliant”): [___]
- Data residency / region constraints (public-safe): [___]

7) Confidential information; NDAs; public information
- Nothing in this Consent requires either party to disclose Confidential Information.
- This Consent does not modify any existing NDA/MSA/DPA/BAA.
- Redwood will not publish Customer Confidential Information.
- If Customer requests anonymization/de-identification, Redwood will only use mutually agreed, public-safe language.

8) Ownership; trademarks
- Customer retains all rights in Customer’s trademarks, logos, and brand assets.
- Redwood retains all rights in Redwood’s materials, templates, and marketing content, subject to Customer’s approved rights and restrictions in this Consent.
- Redwood may resize Customer’s logo or convert file formats solely for display purposes, without altering the logo’s design.

9) Term and revocation
9.1 Term
This Consent remains in effect for twenty-four (24) months from the Effective Date unless revoked earlier under Section 9.2.

9.2 Revocation
Customer may revoke this Consent for future use at any time by written notice to: legal@redwoodinference.com (and copying Customer’s Redwood account team).

Upon revocation:
- Redwood will stop using Customer’s name/logo/quotes/metrics in new materials and new public postings.
- Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to remove or update existing public materials under Redwood’s control within thirty (30) days.
- Limitations: Redwood is not responsible for materials already distributed or cached by third parties (e.g., screenshots, third-party re-posts, search engine caches), but Redwood will use reasonable efforts to request removal where practical.

10) Compliance with laws; relationship of the parties
Each party will comply with applicable laws and regulations related to the activities described in this Consent. Nothing herein creates a partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship.

11) Publicity coordination and points of contact
Customer point of contact for approvals:
Name: [___]
Title: [___]
Email: [___]

Redwood point of contact:
Name: Camila Reyes (VP Marketing)
Email: [___]@redwoodinference.com

Legal escalation contact:
legal@redwoodinference.com

12) Governing law
This Consent will be governed by the laws of the State of [California/Delaware] without regard to conflict of laws principles.

13) Entire agreement (for this subject)
This Consent represents the entire agreement between the parties regarding the specific permissions described herein and supersedes prior discussions on the same subject. Any amendments must be in writing (including email confirmation) and signed/approved by both parties.

14) Signatures
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Consent as of the Effective Date.

CUSTOMER: [Customer Legal Name]

By: ________________________________
Name: ______________________________
Title: _______________________________
Date: _______________________________

REDWOOD INFERENCE, INC.

By: ________________________________
Name: Michael Grant
Title: Legal
Date: _______________________________

Appendix A (optional) — Approved materials list / notes
- Approved logo file(s): [link or filename]
- Approved quote(s) and attribution: [paste exact text]
- Approved metrics (exact/range/qualitative) + caveats: [paste exact text]
- Any additional restrictions: [___]

Internal notes (Redwood-only; remove before sending):
- Ensure Customer is tagged in HubSpot as “Reference: consent signed (date)” once executed.
- Confirm whether Customer requires security/compliance sign-off (Helios-type process) and adjust review window if needed.
- For reference calls, confirm monthly cap and “cooldown” preference; share with AE/CSM and add to reference-call brief template.
